data.title: ONE by Binghatti
data.about:
Experience the epitome of sophistication and luxury with One by Binghatti Developers at Business Bay. This new residential development offers a range of premium apartments in Dubai, situated along the picturesque waterfront. One by Binghatti redefines modern living with its exquisite design and unparalleled amenities, ensuring an elevated lifestyle in the heart of the city.

Select from premium studios, 1-bedroom royal suites, 2-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom apartments, 3 Bedroom villas and 4-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is meticulously designed to provide comfort and elegance, featuring high-end finishes, spacious layouts, and stunning views of the Dubai skyline and the waterfront. The prime location of One by Binghatti for sale allows residents easy access to world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options, making it the perfect choice for those seeking luxury waterfront living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Your Journey of Luxury at One by Binghatti
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Accessibility: Convenient access to major roads including E11 Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al A’amal Street, and Marasi Drive. Ideal for holiday homes with easy availability of metro, Uber, and taxis.
  • Panoramic Views: Stunning views of the Dubai skyline, including iconic landmarks like Burj Khalifa, Dubai Water Canal (Marasi Marina), and Dubai Creek.
  • Retail and Shopping: On-site high-end retail outlets and proximity to major shopping centers, ensuring convenience and luxury.
  • Luxury Wellness and Leisure: Access to exclusive wellness and leisure facilities within the project, providing a luxurious lifestyle.
  • High Rental Yield: Potential for high rental yields and strong historical appreciation in property values within the area, making it an attractive investment.
  • Prime Location: One of the last available off-plan plots in Business Bay, offering a unique investment opportunity.
  • Sustainability: Energy-efficient buildings with sustainable high-end materials and finishing, promoting eco-friendly living.

location_tile.title: Live your Best life at One by Binghatti Business Bay
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
One by Binghatti Business Bay is strategically positioned to provide excellent connectivity to major parts of Dubai. Property for sale at One by Binghatti is just minutes away from Downtown Dubai, the Dubai Mall, and the iconic Burj Khalifa. The Business Bay Metro Station is a short walk away, offering easy access to the city's extensive public transport network. The area is surrounded by numerous dining, shopping, and entertainment options, including high-end restaurants, luxury retail outlets, and vibrant nightlife venues.

  • 05 Minutes - Dubai Mall
  • 10 Minutes - Jumeirah Beach
  • 10 Minutes - Museum of The Future
  • 15 Minutes - Burj Al Arab
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
  • 25 Minutes - Dubai Marina
